race.comment: Keen to stick with the unbeaten AURORA BELLE (7) who made a strong statement at her Australian debut with a dominant win at Ballarat in a BM66, backing up the two wins in New Zealand. She'll roll forward again and prove very hard to run down. MISTY WHISPER (11) has been good in four runs to date, a good winner two back at Seymour before a close-up effort here. Off a let-up but will be rattling home. SILVER DAGGER (5) resumes. She was running in some good races in Tasmania last time in and warrants respect, market watch advised. YUM (10) usually races well second-up so can improve on her seventh when resuming at Mornington.
